item.title: New Shluchim to Richmond, BC
item.description: Chabad of Richmond, British Columbia, has welcomed new shluchim, Rabbi Menachem and Esther Miriam Wolf (née Golomb), who have joined the Chabad House to further expand Jewish life in the community. Full Story

item.title: Picture of the Day
item.description: Rabbi Mendel Kotlarsky, Director of Operations at Keren Hashluchim, the Kinus Office, and Merkos 302, celebrated his 70th birthday with a Shiur at the Ohel taught by his close friend Rabbi Simon Jacobson, and a Farbrengen. He was presented with a photo collage capturing his moments with the Rebbe. More

item.title: Shluchos Join Farbrengen For Evening of Inspiration
item.description: On Thursday evening of the Kinus, Shluchos joined the annual Shluchos Farbregen hosted by the Shluchim Office for an evening of unity, inspiration and connection. Full Story, Photos

item.title: CHYE Workspace Moves Into Artisan Bakehouse After Flooding
item.description: When the CHYE Workspace in Crown Heights was flooded due to severe weather, the Brooklyn Artisan Bakehouse opened its doors as a business center. Full Story

item.title: Singer Releases “Shomer” Song of Jewish Pride
item.description: Singer Mendel Goldman released a new single, which he composed and produced, about Jewish pride in the face of adversities. Video

item.title: Biographer of Frierdiker Rebbe Concludes Whirlwind Tour
item.description: Rabbi David Eliezrie, author of the new biography of the Frierdiker Rebbe, recently spoke in 10 cities in 4 countries and was interviewed on 3 podcasts. Full Story, Video

item.title: 4,578 Teens Will Travel to New York for Largest CTeen Shabbaton This Week
item.description: 4,578 teens from 486 cities arriving in Crown Heights for the 18th annual Shabbaton, the largest gathering of Jewish teens in the world, and the largest in the event's history. Full Story

item.title: Dancing Welcomes the Joyous Month of Adar in 770
item.description: Joyous dancing took place at 770 Eastern Parkway on Rosh Chodesh Adar, joined by many teens who are participating in the CTeen Shabbaton weekend, to celebrate the beginning of the month of Adar. Photos, Video

item.title: New Torah to Be Dedicated in Memory of Baby
item.description: On Sunday, Hei Adar (February 22), a new Sefer Torah written in memory of Etty Lipszyc, a”h -daughter of Rabbi Shalom and Rochel Leah Lipszyc - will be completed and dedicated at the Chabad house in Woodbury, Long Island. Full Story
